name: 1pcs 110ml Soft Silicone Squeezing Feeding Bottle Cute Newborn Baby Training Rice Paste Spoon Infant Cereal Food Supplement Feeder for Toddler Infant Food Dispensing and Feeding
description:
Specification: 
Product Name:Silicone Baby Feeding Bottle 
Material:Silicone 
Color:Pink 
Usage:Squeeze Baby Feeding 
Application:Born Baby Feeding 
Feature:100% Eco-friendly 
Keywords:Squeezable Silicone Bottle 
Weight:115g 
Capacity:110ml 

Features: 
Package includes: baby silicone feeding bottle, each measures: 20.3 x 5.2 cm/ 8 x 2.05 inch 
Safe material: Baby spoon feeder is made of quality PP and silicone, safe, without BPA, it will not hurt the baby's delicate mouth 
Using and cleaning: Simply fill the silicone bottle with the pureed food and control the amount of feeding baby; Disassemble the bottle and put it into water after using. 
Bottle Filters & Dust Cover: The food feeder comes with a bottle filters to prevent baby from choking. It also has dust cover to isolation dust. 
2 in 1: Both bowl and spoon are integrated for easy feeding. Could be used for multiple pureed food.
